headline: Peru Central Reserve Bank Reports Mortgage Credit Growth of 7.8% in September
summary: Peru's Central Reserve Bank reported that mortgage credit accelerated its year-on-year growth rate from 7.6 percent in August to 7.8 percent in September 2026.
why: Mortgage lending growth indicators provide insight into domestic real estate demand, household leverage, and banking sector credit expansion.

impacts.name: Peruvian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Accelerating mortgage credit growth points to rising consumer real estate financing activity.
